Dear Casey,

We filed the corporation's T2 return and its GST/HST return with the CRA.

A. 2026 corporate tax
- The T2 return shows a balance owing of $800. It is due to the CRA by March 31, 2027.
- Please pay $800 by March 31, 2027. The CRA charges interest on any amount not paid by the due date. Pay to business number 000000001 RC 0001.
- The amount may change slightly once the CRA sends its Notice of Assessment. Please forward it to us when it arrives.

B. 2026 GST/HST
- The GST/HST return shows a balance owing of $3,100. It was due to the CRA by January 31, 2027.
- Please pay $3,100 now. Pay to business number 000000001 RT 0001. This is a different account from A, so make it a separate payment.
- The CRA may add a late penalty and interest to this amount too.

C. How to pay
Pay through your online banking or through CRA My Payment on the CRA website. Each amount above is its own payment.

D. Your documents
Your compiled financial statements, full T2 return, signed T183CORP, CRA e-file confirmation, GST/HST return and minute book letter (please forward it to your lawyer) are in your TaxDome portal. The CRA requires you to keep them for 6 years.
